# luhongshuai.com - Astraea Plan

> 企业级AI智能体集群架构 · 魔方小镇城市书房

## About
luhongshuai.com is the official website for Astraea Plan (formerly 玉衡计划), an enterprise-grade AI agent cluster architecture. It showcases how a 150+ store chain (魔方小镇城市书房) deploys 17 AI agents across departments using Hermes Agent framework.

## Key Topics
- Enterprise AI agent architecture (17 agents, 12 departments)
- Hermes Agent framework deployment
- Multi-agent orchestration and A2A communication
- Real-world retail AI implementation
- Obsidian vault as agent memory system

## Site Structure
- / - Landing page with architecture overview
- /sitemap.xml - Full site map
